1.web: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
1.asv: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

2.web: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
2.asv: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

3.web: For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.
3.asv: For Jehovah is a great God, And a great King above all gods.

4.web: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
4.asv: In his hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the mountains are his also.

5.web: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
5.asv: The sea is his, and he made it; And his hands formed the dry land.

6.web: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,
6.asv: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker:

7.web: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
7.asv: For he is our God, And we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day, oh that ye would hear his voice!

8.web: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
8.asv: Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;

9.web: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
9.asv: When your fathers tempted me, Proved me, and saw my work.

10.web: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “It is a people that errs in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
10.asv: Forty years long was I grieved with that generation, And said, It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known my ways:

11.web: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
11.asv: Wherefore I sware in my wrath, That they should not enter into my rest.
